recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全被一致性的中至大型單核細胞取代，核圓、染色質細緻並有小核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色，殘存的正常造血細胞極少，並可見核分裂；形態不能判定系別，需流式證實 CD56+、sCD3− 的 NK 細胞。
features: Marrow aspirate replaced by a monotonous sheet of intermediate to large mononuclear cells
Round to slightly oval nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin and small but visible nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm without conspicuous azurophilic granules at this magnification
Occasional mitotic figure within the infiltrate
Few residual normal elements, including small lymphocytes, an eosinophilic myelocyte and scattered red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of intermediate to large mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm; granules are not conspicuous at this magnification. A mitotic figure is present, and residual hematopoietic elements are sparse. The morphology resembles blasts and does not establish lineage. With flow cytometry showing surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive NK cells and EBV positivity, the findings are consistent with aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts express CD34/CD117, MPO or monocytic markers (CD14, CD64) and lack cytoplasmic CD3E and EBER.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and are TdT and CD34 positive, whereas NK leukemia cells are TdT negative mature NK cells.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD123+/TCF4+ and EBV negative, although it also expresses CD56.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138+/CD38 bright with light chain restriction.
